claims.statement: Tom Allen and William M. Davis signed articles of agreement on 4 December 1868 for a prize fight under the new rules of the English Prize Ring.
claims.excerpt:
Articles of agreement entered into, this 4th day of
December, 1868, between William M. Davis and
Thomas Alien.

claims.statement: Bill Ryall signed the articles of agreement on behalf of Thomas Allen.
claims.excerpt:
WM. RYALL,
On behalf ot Thomas Allen,

claims.statement: The second deposit of $200 a side for the Allen and Davis fight was to be made at William Ryall's house, 417 Washington avenue, St. Louis, on Friday 18 December 1868.
claims.excerpt:

claims.statement: The third and final deposit of $500 a side for the Allen and Davis fight was to be made at Mike McCoole's house, St. Louis, on Monday 4 January 1869.

ouse of Mr. Mike MeCoole. St. Louis, on Monday,

claims.statement: Tom Allen was training for the Davis fight in the neighborhood of Cleveland, Ohio.
claims.excerpt:
His field of operations
is in the neighborhood of Cleveland, Ohio.

claims.statement: Charles Convy Gallagher, a Cleveland fighter, was described as a warm friend of Tom Allen.
